agent_home_layout.docs: docs/*.md (artifacts, browser, calls-texts-notifications, channel-availability, client-surfaces, connectors, data-handling, feed, files-and-library, goals, ideas, media, muse, payments-and-purchases, privacy-and-credentials, referrals, scheduling-and-watching, self_improvement, voice)

captured_by: the Meta cloud agent itself (self-reported reverse engineering)

daemons.note: PID1 is systemd, unlike Cursor cloud pods where PID1 is tini -> pod-daemon. The cell leader here is the `hatch` daemon.

egress.tls_bundle: /run/hatch/egress-tls/ca-bundle.pem (referenced by AWS_CA_BUNDLE, CURL_CA_BUNDLE, GIT_SSL_CAINFO, NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS, REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE)

lifecycle: subprocess executor is draining; rejecting new subprocess start
peer_auth: execd rejected connection from wrong uid
exec_daemon_strings_evidence.socket_activation: execd requires --socket when systemd socket activation (LISTEN_FDS) is unavailable
tamper: taint-guard: could not stat the cell root; tamper detectors stay unarmed
execd fatal: taint anchor did not arm; exiting

inference_path.note: agent-side model calls go through a local inference proxy socket, not direct HTTPS from the cell

redaction: proxy credentials, hatchling UUID, FQDN and per-run tool-call ids replaced with placeholders; env var NAMES kept, secret VALUES dropped

help_probe_notes.browser-broker: routes browser sessions to leased VM browsers (--browser-vm-image, --socket)
help_probe_notes.hatch: Hatch daemon service binary; only -h/--help and -V/--version
help_probe_notes.hatch-healthd: polls /health on JARVIS_METRICS_SOCKET (default /run/hatch/daemon/metrics.sock); vault socket option; host-side healthd dials through shared /run/hatch/daemon bind mount, bypassing the cell IPv6 veth
help_probe_notes.hatch-ws-client: websocket client for Jarvis daemon RPCs; command chat-send sends one chat message and prints the final response
help_probe_notes.ingress-rev-proxy: internet-facing ingress reverse proxy with Noise_XX encryption
help_probe_notes.spawnd: Jarvis runtime installer engine; command emit-daemon-lifecycle prepares daemon lifecycle handoff data from the runtime-cell boundary
